audit_rules: BWV553-556 and BWV576 cannot have a Bach compone edge. Source catalog Bach placement is not compositional certification.
BWV565 debated not conclusively spurious, preserve Ringk manuscript witness and author attribution HOLD; BWV583 posthumous sources, no false chorale label.
BWV578 raw source title in G major retained, staging display corrected to G minor without corrupting source node.
BWV556 guide page heading 'Toccata and fugue' conflicts with BWV553–560 short prelude/fugue family and worklist; retain alert and no unsupported crosswork identity.
Reincken original Sonata No3 in Hortus Musicus -> Bach keyboard adaptation BWV966; Flaminio says II, unresolved source disagreement documented.
Whole BWV539 ID distinct from previously imported BWV539/2 movement documentary; connect PART OF, preserve previous BWV1001 fugue derivation.
Six English Suites: 5 sourced by Flaminio in these 50 worklist rows; BWV810 sixth is documentary external reference, not a 501st source row.
BWV988 exactly aria and thirty internal variations, aria da capo a reprise, one composition; BWV989 separate aria plus ten internal variations.
BWV906 fugue incomplete 48 surviving bars; BWV582 passacaglia+fugue one composition; BWV552 opens/closes Clavier-Übung III, parts not adjacent.
All type/ring relations rooted with no fanout, collections are not equivalent to single work; remaining global identity and browser tests not passed.
